.. py:class:: ColorLayer(config_file_path: str | None = None, input_path: str | None = None, output_path: str | None = None, metadata_path: str | None = None, metadata_type: str | None = None, metadata: paidiverpy.metadata_parser.MetadataParser = None, config: paidiverpy.config.config.Configuration = None, logger: logging.Logger | None = None, images: paidiverpy.images_layer.ImagesLayer = None, paidiverpy: paidiverpy.Paidiverpy = None, step_name: str | None = None, parameters: dict | None = None, config_index: int | None = None, raise_error: bool = False, verbose: int = 2, track_changes: bool = True, n_jobs: int = 1)

   Bases: :py:obj:`paidiverpy.Paidiverpy`


   ColorLayer class.

   Process the images in the color layer.

   :param config_file_path: The path to the configuration file.
   :type config_file_path: str
   :param input_path: The path to the input files.
   :type input_path: str
   :param output_path: The path to the output files.
   :type output_path: str
   :param metadata_path: The path to the metadata file.
   :type metadata_path: str
   :param metadata_type: The type of the metadata file.
   :type metadata_type: str
   :param metadata: The metadata object.
   :type metadata: MetadataParser
   :param config: The configuration object.
   :type config: Configuration
   :param logger: The logger object.
   :type logger: logging.Logger
   :param images: The images object.
   :type images: ImagesLayer
   :param paidiverpy: The paidiverpy object.
   :type paidiverpy: Paidiverpy
   :param step_name: The name of the step.
   :type step_name: str
   :param parameters: The parameters for the step.
   :type parameters: dict
   :param config_index: The index of the configuration.
   :type config_index: int
   :param raise_error: Whether to raise an error.
   :type raise_error: bool
   :param verbose: verbose level (0 = none, 1 = errors/warnings, 2 = info).
   :type verbose: int
   :param track_changes: Whether to track changes. Defaults to True.
   :type track_changes: bool
   :param n_jobs: The number of jobs to run in parallel.
   :type n_jobs: int


   .. py:attribute:: step_name


   .. py:attribute:: step_metadata


   .. py:method:: run(add_new_step: bool = True) -> paidiverpy.images_layer.ImagesLayer | None

      Color layer run method.

      Run the color layer steps on the images based on the configuration
      file or parameters.

      :param add_new_step: Whether to add a new step to the images object.
      :type add_new_step: bool, optional

      Defaults to True.

      :raises ValueError: The mode is not defined in the configuration file.

      :returns: The images object with the new step added.
      :rtype: Union[ImagesLayer, None]

      :type image_data: np.ndarray
      :param params: Parameters for the grayscale conversion.
      :type params: GrayScaleParams, optional

   .. py:method:: deblur(image_data: numpy.ndarray, params: paidiverpy.config.color_params.DeblurParams = None) -> numpy.ndarray

      Deblurring.

      Method to apply deblurring to the image.

      :param image_data: The image to apply deblurring.
      :type image_data: np.ndarray
      :param params: Params for method.
      :type params: DeblurParams, optional

      Defaults to DeblurParams().

      :raises ValueError: Unknown PSF type. Please use 'gaussian' or 'motion'.
      :raises ValueError: Unknown method type. Please use 'wiener'.
      :raises NotImplementedError: Unknown method type. Please use 'wiener'.
      :raises ValueError: Error applying contrast adjustment.

      :returns: The image with deblurring applied.
      :rtype: np.ndarray

      :type img: np.ndarray

      :type bw_img: np.ndarray

      :type deconv_iter: int

      :type deconv_mask_weight: float

      :type small_float_val: float, optional

      :returns: The deconvolved image
